ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-08-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: P. Dias/Sajja R, Reporter: Margaret Del Coto. Petitioner Andrew Tsui was sworn and examined through his Spanish Interpreter, Charles Zhangi. Court grants Decree changing Petitioner's name to Andrew Z. Wang. Decree signed in open court.
